comment: The prebuilt libwebrtc that LiveKit's webrtc-sys-build downloads, pinned by SHA-256 (scripts/fetch_libwebrtc.py). When Cargo.lock moves to another webrtc-sys-build, its WEBRTC_TAG may change: read it in that crate's src/lib.rs, and take the digests from `gh api repos/livekit/rust-sdks/releases/tags/<tag> --jq '.assets[] | {name, digest}'`.
